response.sql: WITH group_metrics AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_fee_count FROM group_metrics), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gm.avg_ratio, gm.fee_count, ac.avg_fee_count, gm.fee_count - ac.avg_fee_count AS excess FROM group_metrics gm CROSS JOIN avg_count ac WHERE gm.fee_count > ac.avg_fee_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(fee_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM filtered_groups
